before_decision.evidence: Berkeley §§13.2.3–13.2.4, printed pp.323–327 (/tmp/scope-df-berkeley.txt:18792–19130), derive the completed universal R and quantum Schur-Weyl duality before §13.3 introduces Kashiwara operators. Thus the asserted crystal prerequisite is false for these source results. Current QG-1 promises neither. The destination quantum-affine-type-a-and-level-one-fock-space at order1534 and plan-quantum-groups-track.md QG-6 lines177–200 declare finite/semi-infinite affine q-wedges/Fock action, not universal finite-type R or quantum Schur-Weyl duality; an R-1 wedge relation is not that theorem. QG-5 also explicitly distinguishes a weightwise quasi-R from a universal R. Owner must split and choose valid future destinations without inventing coverage; no new page/forward edge added.

Exact QG-5/6 inventories distinguish weightwise quasi-R bars and affine q-wedges/Fock from these results. Current QG-1 asserts neither theorem. Owner resolves both as deferred uncommissioned future material outside this build; sentinel owner-decision is an explicit disposition, not a pending decision.
